decisions.reason: As a standalone offering that extends the firm’s core analytics and platform logic in a growing market, it is likely at or near aspiration and worth retaining under the firm’s available innovation slack.
This product is very close to the established tariff and market-data business and its dedicated web presence suggests enough expected demand to keep it while results continue to form.
Because it directly fits the firm’s core electricity-process capabilities and was presented as a distinct offer, management would likely keep it rather than reallocate those resources prematurely.

Given its weaker market prominence and likely overlap with the firm’s other tariff calculators, management would treat it as falling short of aspiration and redirect resources to stronger adjacent products.
The tool supports the firm’s broader platform and regional tariff applications, and its dedicated presentation indicates sufficient strategic value to continue despite early-stage uncertainty.

With only limited visibility and probable duplication of nearby comparison products, this offer would likely be judged below aspiration and its resources better used in the established business or next developments.
